ui.020: Discover the mission behind TT Rocket Stars
ui.021: TT Rocket Stars is an educational space-adventure game for practicing multiplication tables and division in a fun way. Each mission offers maths challenges, tracks progress and encourages steady improvement.
ui.022: The game takes inspiration from some ideas in Times Tables Rock Stars (TT Rock Stars), but is a different creation, with its own space theme, gameplay and presentation. It is not affiliated with or endorsed by its creators.
ui.024: Free-to-share game. You may distribute it at no cost.
ui.029: Offline space music and game sounds. Audio begins when you interact with the game.
ui.039: 12 original space soundtracks. Enjoy the music even without an Internet connection.
